name: Saya NEO
source:
Faction: Asmodian
Skill: The Tentacle (Za Tentakuru), Fold in Crisis, Fold in Crisis the Summer Festival (fold in crisis the Matsuri)
Artist: [url=/s533]Kagami Hirotaka[/url]
Cards: [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/8b88decb6f85b4da6c275d0e4a1687ca.png]AS 5 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/9b03876379a19935981637f64c7239f4.png]AS 5 Stars EX[/url]
History:
After the death of the original [url=/c33747]Saya[/url], the UFS collected data and DNA fragments.
Saya Neo is the recreated and strongly modified end product of UFS research and experiment. She is a demon far less insane than her original and seen as a completed version. 
[spoiler]Saya Neo would serve under an unnamed UFS group, until she got lost in the dark cities. She later joined the DSO after her recovery, and follows the orders of [url=/c66560]Koukawa Oboro[/url] and [url=/c66513]Koukawa Asuka[/url], in TABA and RPGX. Saya Neo may not exist within the original timeline.[/spoiler]
[From [url=https://breezewiki.com/taimanin/wiki/Saya_Neo]breezewiki.com[/url]]
